summary: Alector, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $75.03 million underwritten follow-on common stock offering of 36.6 million shares at $2.05 per share, versus a $1.91 last sale on October 15, 2026, implying a roughly 7.3% premium to the prior close. Underwriting discounts of $0.123 per share leave $1.927 net per share and about $70.5 million gross proceeds before expenses; Morgan Stanley and BTIG are joint active bookrunners, with settlement expected October 19, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and dilution overhang.
